title: Rex v1: the send-off loop
goal: Open a plan in Rex, see its outline and pinned task, watch the agent work it on the tape, mark it done with a retrospective, and type sendoff to get a brief you paste into the next chat. Rex stays watch-only: it never sends, approves, or steers.

in: v1 plan JSON: parse, show, pin, complete
send-off brief generated from the plan file
drift from the pinned task, shown in Rex only
opt-in hooks for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode next to Cursor
out: injecting prompts or plans into the agent
a custom plan language or a web UI

tasks.title: Plans you can read
does: A plan file has a frozen v1 shape and Rex shows it as an outline

tasks.title: Freeze the v1 plan format
does: internal/plan parses v1 and reports problems instead of failing
Create writes an empty v1 stub instead of {}
docs/plan-format.md is the contract

tasks.title: Edit a plan without disturbing it
needs: internal/jsonedit splices one member and keeps every other byte
does: Status and completion edits touch only the target task's members
A file changed on disk since it was read is re-checked, never clobbered
verify: golden diffs: a pin changes only status values

tasks.title: Outline, plan detail, task detail
does: Opening a plan lands on its outline
External edits reload with a toast; invalid JSON keeps the last good copy
verify: open → outline → task detail → Esc → library in tmux at 78 and 38 columns

tasks.title: Pin, complete, send off
does: The pinned task drives completion, the send-off brief, and drift

tasks.title: Pin one task
does: p⏎ pins the selected leaf task; the status line shows it
verify: pinning writes active on the target and pending on the old pin, nothing else

tasks.title: Mark the pin done with a retrospective
does: d⏎ opens a completion overlay prefilled from the agent's trailer and the tape, and writes accomplished, modified, verified_how
verify: git diff shows only that task's lines

tasks.title: Type sendoff, get a brief
does: s⏎ builds the issue #9 brief from the JSON and shows it to copy
verify: golden brief from a fixture plan
an empty plan says nothing to send

tasks.title: Copy the brief honestly
does: The brief is copied with the platform tool or OSC 52, and the view says which

tasks.title: Show drift from the pin
does: Edits and prompts off the pinned task show soft or hard drift in Rex only
verify: nothing is written to the feed, the plan, or stdout

tasks.title: More agents on the tape
does: Codex and OpenCode report to the same feed, opt-in

tasks.title: Codex hooks
does: rex ingest --install codex writes hooks.json; MapCodex reads hook payloads

tasks.title: OpenCode plugin
does: rex ingest --install opencode writes a plugin that pipes events to rex ingest

tasks.title: rex-plan skill
does: Agents that load the skill write v1 plans and end replies with the trailer

tasks.title: Install scripts
does: install.sh and install.ps1 build from any ref and print the opt-in commands

tasks.title: Create → pin → watch → complete → send off
does: The whole loop works end to end in a real terminal
verify: a tmux walk of every CUJ step at 80×24 and 60×20
